summary: NextBoat Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $510,000 loan from Greentree Financial Group, evidenced by a 10% convertible promissory note with a 10% OID (net proceeds ~$459,000). The note matures August 14, 2028, bears 10% interest (18% on default), and converts at $1.785 per share, subject to reset and anti-dilution adjustments. A warrant for 100,000 shares at $1.785 with down-round protection and 20,000 commitment shares were also issued. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation; focus on potential dilution and conversion terms.
